description: Implementation of filesystem interface functions for LVGL on Zephyr OS, including file operations, directory handling, and error code translation.

methods.name: lvgl_fs_ready
methods.description: Callback to indicate filesystem driver is ready.

methods.name: errno_to_lv_fs_res
methods.description: Converts standard error codes to LVGL filesystem result codes.

methods.name: lvgl_fs_open
methods.description: Opens a file given a path and mode.

methods.name: lvgl_fs_read
methods.description: Reads data from an open file.

methods.name: lvgl_fs_write
methods.description: Writes data to an open file.

methods.name: lvgl_fs_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in an open file.

methods.name: lvgl_fs_tell
methods.description: Gets current position in an open file.

methods.name: lvgl_fs_dir_read
methods.description: Reads next entry in directory (not implemented).

methods.name: lvgl_fs_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers the LVGL filesystem driver.
